programme.title: Tanked

programme.desc: Gumball and Hotdog Kid discover why they're so awkward with each other.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 6

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 6
programme.desc: Gumball finds Penny's laugh annoying but can't think of a way to tell her without offending her. When he discovers that Principal Brown has the same problem with Miss Simian's morning breath they decide to swap problems to save themselves from getting dumped.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 6
programme.desc: Everything in Elmore is suddenly just various shades of grey and things all over town are going wrong. programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 6
programme.desc: A group of kids get locked in the school after their parents have a charity gala. They appoint Gumball as leader to get them out but it leads to chaos.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 6
programme.desc: Gumball and Darwin argue with the Internet.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 6
programme.desc: Gumball and Darwin learn that Hector is not so happy being giant-sized. So they decide to help him by creating a potion that will shrink him down to the size of an average person. programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 6
programme.desc: Wishing to get rid of Gumball once and for all his nemesis Rob offers up a variety of reality action and comedy shows featuring characters other than Gumball. Unfortunately for Rob each one is worse than the last…

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 6
programme.desc: Penny's family is unhappy that she's decided to come out of her shell… literally. And Penny wants her family to come out of their shells...also literally. programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 6
programme.desc: Channel 6 Elmore News has all the top local stories.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 6
programme.desc: The Wattersons are forced to rent out their house.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 6
programme.desc: Everyone assumes Darwin and Carrie's relationship is doomed as they're so different. That is everyone except Darwin and Carrie. When Carrie's cool ghostly ex-boyfriend turns up Gumball decides to get Darwin to confront what's really going on.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 6
programme.desc: Anais and psycho Jamie are accused of the same crime.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 6
programme.desc: Dad decides to resolve the Watterson family's differences.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 6
programme.desc: When Gumball and Darwin's conversation dries up they worry that their friendship is coming to an end. They try to find ways to get the conversation flowing again but nothing seems to work. Maybe they have just grown apart?

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: Skinny might be a man of science, but he’s more than happy to get his fortune told for a laugh. The palm-reader sees alarming visions of Skinny’s near future; mostly visions that relate to Skinny being squashed, smooshed or otherwise smeared. It’s kind of Skinny’s own fault; maybe if he paid a bit less attention to chasing Lamput and a bit more attention to not getting squashed, smooshed or smeared, he wouldn’t need constant rescuing by a frazzled mystic.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 6

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - Season 4
programme.desc: Gumball and Darwin go to extreme lengths to help Molly make her dull stories more interesting.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4

In a Mayan Temple, the Lemmings discover a magic bracelet that increases one’s sense of smell tenfold and use it to find the jar. Grizzy loses their trail, but finds some Mayan bracelets himself: one for eyesight and one for hearing. Enough to infallibly track down the Lemmings!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4

While toying with an ancestral console, the Lemmings set off a cosmic phenomenon that brings the moon, which is now the size of a disco ball, to the temple. In its aura, gravity becomes very weak. Enough to get rid of Grizzy and have a very original fiesta.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4

Determined to continue playing, the Lemmings trick the bear. But when the tablet hits the circuit breaker and explodes, the gaming animals come to life! Ice dinosaurs, laser caribous and giant carnivorous plants. The life-size hunt can begin!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: A snowstorm rips the solar panels off the log cabin and Grizzy can no longer watch TV or enjoy the comforts of home! But he has a brilliant idea. He produces electricity by making a caribou run on a treadmill, using the last carrot in the house as bait. But the Lemmings absolutely want his carrot to make the perfect snowman.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy discovers in shock that the TV has been replaced with a trompe-l’oeil image. Furious, he flushes the Lemmings out of their hiding place where they’d hoped to watch their favorite cartoon in peace and propels them as far as possible. They land in an ancient cave where a powerful spirit capable of entering individuals is asleep. The Lemmings decide to free the spirit and send it to Grizzy. But will they be able to control the spirit?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Not easy to enjoy a DVD about salmon when the Lemmings are having a disco party right there. Grizzy sends them packing with such force that they land at the research station, where they discover a state-of-the-art U.V. cabin. When turned up to the max, the light therapy and music options can advantageously replace the disco equipment Grizzy destroyed. The noise they make causes a block of ice to break off. It hurdles down the slope to the cabin and destroys Grizzy’s TV. But it doesn’t take the bear long to figure out that the U.V. cabin also has a DVD function.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings have fun destroying ice towers. When Grizzy sees them, it inspires him to sculpt statues of himself. The Lemmings cannot resist the temptation to destroy the statues of Grizzy, who does everything in his power to protect them.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: A container adrift along the icefield will change the lives of Grizzy and the Lemmings: it’s an inexhaustible stock of chocolate spread! There is so much, that for the first time the close enemies have no need to fight over the treat. They entice a flock of penguins into hoisting the container out of the water. One of the penguins, who did not get his reward in fish, is disgruntled. Grizzy has him taste the Yummy, then throws the jar far away to get rid of the penguin. The chocolate treat spreads over the icefield. Fatal error?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy uses a fire extinguisher to chase the Lemmings from the living room so that he can take a nap, but the gadget accidentally flies out the window. It lands at the top of an ice cliff, causing a fissure, and the peak of the cliff topples. Amid the debris, the Lemmings discover a fearsome creature: the Yeti, who is looking for the guilty party. The Lemmings bring him to Grizzy, never dreaming that the giant will immediately fall in love with the Ranger’s cabin and throw a very original party.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings are bored. A coconut rolls over to Grizzy’s feet, pulling the bear out of his state of torpor. He imagines a sort of face on the nut and decides to care for it, like a child with its doll. He has so much fun playing with his new toy that the Lemmings want to join in. But when the bear refuses, the Lemmings ruse: they hide inside other coconuts in hopes of being adopted by Grizzy!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: While bickering with the Lemmings over control of the TV, Grizzy sees an illustration that gives him an idea. In a medical book, a person whose leg is in a cast is being served dinner in front of a TV. Grizzy pretends to have a twisted ankle and shows the Lemmings the patient care illustrations. The imaginary invalid Grizzy is so convincing that the Lemmings fall for the trick. They think that the sooner Grizzy is healed, the sooner they will be able to throw him out of the cabin as planned.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: On the beach, the Lemmings have set up a mini funfair for tourists. Each attraction lets you to win tickets, which are then used to collect prizes from a vending machine. Grizzy, who is not very good at games of skill, steals the tickets collected by the Lemmings in order to obtain the jackpot. The Lemmings decide to create an attraction just for him.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover that oysters can make pearls almost instantaneously: just put an object inside their shell and it’s automatically coated with mother-of-pearl The game of marbles that the Lemmings have invented with pearls is driving Grizzy crazy. He manages to catapult the Lemmings far away. But at the ocean bottom, they discover a giant oyster. All they need to create a giant-scale marble game!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings have adopted a small exotic fish that’s lively and affectionate and have fun decorating its aquarium. Jealous, Grizzy finds a fish too, but his is expressionless and indifferent to the bear’s efforts to communicate. Grizzy plots to exchange the two fish behind the Lemmings' backs. He puts the affectionate fish in an even bigger aquarium with a pharaonic decor and locks the lid. But the Lemmings have no intention of leaving their friend to Grizzy.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings use all the cans and tins they can get their hands on to build a beach slide. Grizzy, annoyed at not finding his tinned fish to prepare his meal tray, recovers them from the Lemmings. In their struggle, Grizzy loses his badge! Grizzy and the Lemmings now fight over a valuable metal detector that each party needs to accomplish their goal: build a slide or find the beloved badge.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings take a liking to an endangered crab on the beach and decide to shelter it from a seagull who is using its shell to open coconuts. They bring it home to a disgruntled Grizzy, who wants to watch TV in peace while snacking on Cheetos. When the Lemmings turn into full-fledged crab rescuers, the house is soon overrun with crustaceans. Grizzy decides to use the seagull to get rid of the crabs. But the Lemmings - ready to do anything to protect their new friends - embark the entire house, like a raft on water.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings play pirates on a beached boat. Grizzy, who is fishing further down, realizes that with the Lemmings’ boat, he could come closer to a zone that’s teeming with fish. Grizzy takes a malicious pleasure playing pirate himself to unseat the Lemmings and steal their boat. The Lemmings discover a chest containing real pirate belongings. A telescope conjures the owner’s ghost who immediately places his saber and hook at their disposal.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean gets so engrossed playing with Mr Paliwal’s new drone that he doesn’t notice a car thief stealing his car. They quickly jump into Mr Paliwal’s car and use the drone to track the stolen car to the thief’s warehouse hideout. Using the drone, they discover a criminal car-stealing operation – but will they be able to outwit the car thieves using Mr Paliwal’s flying gadget?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Irma is dragging a very bored Mr Bean around a shopping centre when he spots a competition for Minty Mints – pull your silliest face for a photo and win a cash prize! Mr Bean tries to queue but it’s too long - so he persuades Irma to visit a photo studio offering romantic photoshoots. Can Mr Bean get away with pulling funny faces and submit the photo to the Minty Mints people without Irma knowing?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: When Scrapper claws a rip in Teddy, Mr Bean rushes him to the Teddy hospital. As Teddy is being fixed, Mr Bean is rather taken with another Ted on sale in the shop. He decided to take Big Ted home with him once Teddy is fixed. But at home it seems as though Big Ted is freezing Teddy out, and after a particularly terrifying nightmare, Mr Bean realises he has to get rid of his new guest.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean takes Billy to a climbing centre but gets annoyed by a competitive dad who accuses him of being a beginner. Mr Bean insists he’s an expert but is made to prove it when they both compete for a trophy – the winner being the first to climb “The Big One”, a huge, scary wall for adults only! Mr Bean is determined to win but hadn’t counted on the competitive dad’s dirty tricks!

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: Lamput gets mistaken for a guide dog, and the Docs try to nab their quarry without disturbing an old lady's pleasant day in front of the wireless. Good thing she can't see the chaos going on.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: All of MoleTown goes into a cleaning frenzy after Moley tries to explain why humans in the Great Above think dirt is dirty!

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: Moley tries to impress the new ambassador from MoleTown’s sister city, Moledonia, meanwhile the Gardener has schemed up a free tour in order to get his hands on Manny.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: It’s winter in MoleTown and a mysterious snowy creature is roaming the Big Below, the Gardener uses this as the perfect opportunity to try and scare Moley with his own Abominable Snowmole, and catch Manny.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: All of MoleTown enjoys a day at the beach. But when they found out Mona Lisa can’t swim, Mishmosh comes to the rescue with his new submarine invention!

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: MoleTown’s orchestra is performing, and everyone is impressed with Milo’s new hat until Moley accidentally breaks it. Moley must come up with a way to get Milo’s hat back to normal and fast!

programme.title: Tom and Jerry - Season 1
programme.desc: Tom And Jerry take their chase to the skies. Kite-flying has never been this intense. Who will emerge as the ultimate master of strings?

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 2
programme.desc: Chep and Mush-Mush sometimes don’t listen to Lilit. So when she tries to tell them about her great idea to have a special firefly night, they instead believe it is their idea. Grrr! Whose special firefly night will come out on top?

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 2
programme.desc: Bolly hurts his foot and can’t go fast until it heals. Phooey! But when everyone gives him treats to cheer him up, Bolly decides he never wants his foot to heal.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 2
programme.desc: Chep is over-joyed when his weevil friend, Chase, returns to Mushton. But Chase seems to have changed, he's way harder to handle now. And he wants something from Chep! But what?

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 2
programme.desc: Chep has to give the Mushlets a talk about spiders. But talking in front of a group makes Chep nervous. Mush-Mush offers to do it instead. Problem is Mush-Mush’s knowledge of spiders is so bad he ends up getting caught by one!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables - Season 2
programme.desc: The Mushlers want Amanita to join in telling monster stories. But Amanita doesn’t believe in monsters. So they take her on a monster hunt and find more than they imagined.

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power - Season 1
programme.desc: Kid Fury is trapped in the Titan Fury, which is advancing towards Kaboom City. Kid Kazoom and Multy risk everything to rescue him before it's too late.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Old Snelgrove, the senior butler, is retiring. There is an open backyard Olympics on the estate to see who will replace him. When the contestants in the field are narrowed down to Butch and Tom, what will the final outcome be?

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Red Herring complains to Tom and Jerry that he keeps hearing laughter everywhere he goes. Tom and Jerry bodyguard Red to prevent him from doing anything that might provoke laughter, but Red's goof-ups and fails soon have even them convulsed. Gradually, it gets loud enough that Tom and Jerry can hear it too. Will they find the true source of the laughter?

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Tom and Jerry awake to the smell of eggs being cooked in the kitchen – Ginger and Rick are making breakfast courtesy of their neighbor's fresh eggs. Ginger and Rick talk about how their new neighbor has a suburban henhouse and is raising their own produce. Tom and Jerry team up to target the henhouse for a heist, but it's easier said than done.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: A little baby goat butts his head through a distant wall of the estate and starts nibbling the grass. At first, he helps Tom with the yardwork but then causes chaos throughout the manor. Tom and Jerry are left to deal with the kid.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: On another scary night in the castle, The Invisible Cat wants nothing more than to catch mice. After it picks up and carries Jerry and Tuffy, Tom is really confused (and spooked) to see the two mice magically float through the air! When Tom accidentally smacks The Invisible Cat in the face and knocks Jerry and Tuffy free of his hold, it sparks a slapstick fight between the two cats.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings open a nightclub with blasting music and a disco ball in an igloo they have built not far from the cabin. The noise prevents Grizzy from sleeping. The bear confiscates the disco ball and propels the Lemmings far into the distance. They land in an ice cave where they discover a console that lights up the stars in the sky and controls the northern lights. The canopy of heaven starts blinking. The Lemmings transform the ice field into an open-air discotheque!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings come up with a ride worthy of a county fair in the living room. Awakened, Grizzy throws their juice extractor out the window and the rodents land in the neighboring science station where they accidentally wake up… a mammoth! A friendship is born between them. The Lemmings drag the mastodon into their game, and he transforms the entire cabin into a Ferris Wheel. Grizzy, who was trying to doze in peace, wakes up in a panic.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Before an audience of penguins and walruses, two teams of Lemmings perform acrobatic high jumps, competing for the winning prize. When Grizzy accidentally jumps in, he quickly gets caught up in the game and the clapometer goes wild! Intoxicated by his victory, the bear is by no means a modest winner! But the Lemmings want their moment of glory in the limelight as well!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: Alone in the jungle, Clara Tinhorn wrestles with her loneliness, until she stumbles upon a freshly hatched baby crocodile!She names the hatchling Lenny, and the two quickly bond in playful joy! When the Ranchers arrive to check on the crocodile nest, they discover the baby is gone! Furious, the mother croc, Snapfang, unleashes her wrath on the Ranchers, convinced they’ve stolen her child!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: The Ranchers dive deep across the ocean floor, determined to track down Jack’s long-lost rusty anchor! Their search is a success, but the moment they reach for it, the water explodes with motion! A massive plesiosaur charges at them, sending the Ranchers close to the wreck of an ancient ship! Just when a collision seems certain, the beast halts, spooked by something lurking in the depths!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Sometimes Mr. Bean’s Teddy can be no fun at all. Feeling the need for a new friend, Bean buys a parrot. But getting the parrot past his landlady and her one-eyed cat, Scrapper, proves to be no easy task. Next, is trying to get the blasted bird to speak.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: It’s a beautiful day at the beach. Bean breathes in the salty air, bliss - and not another soul in sight. What could possibly spoil his perfect day? Answer: British weather. Mr. Bean finds himself chasing an illusive ray of sunshine across town, over hills and dales, a football stadium and the English Channel.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: While eating breakfast, the Baby Lemmings discover a hot stone near a spring that enables them to cook their food. They find it incredible and decide to start cooking. Baby Owl, asleep nearby, is attracted by the smell and plunders their feast!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Baby Lynx is desperately looking for a worthy opponent to race against. When she sees the Baby Lemmings chasing an apple rolling down a slope, she wants to race against them. But in reality, they are really bad at it! Baby Lynx decides to train the Baby Lemmings in the hope of having real opponents.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: When they fall into a hollow tree stump, the baby lemmings discover the principle of echoes. They have fun making lots of noise and even humming a little because it's so much fun! But they don't realize that when they sing (in tune), it causes the flowers around them to bloom. Meanwhile, the owl would like the noise to stop so she can finally get some sleep. She is determined to silence her noisy neighbors.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: To ease the burden on MOE, the Batwheels use his duplicating machine to make copies of their repair bot, but the Batcave is soon overrun when the machine breaks!

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 3
programme.desc: The Batwheels are shocked to discover that a crime wave taking place in Gotham is being perpetrated by someone very familiar...

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean is in need of a sturdy new bookcase and sets off to visit a furniture warehouse. He finds one that’s perfect but is outraged when he’s told he has to build the bookcase himself! Bean is unfamiliar with flat pack assembly and struggles to construct his new bookcase failing miserably when he discovers he’s one screw short. Mr Bean heads back to the shop only to find it’s closed!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean decides to take Teddy on holiday to the seaside. But when he arrives at his hotel a spoilt little girl wants Teddy all for herself. And her protective dad only wants the best for his ‘princess’. An on-going tussle ensues between Mr Bean the little girl and her Dad resulting in a chase across the seaside town and onto the pier. No one comes between Mr Bean Teddy and their ‘relaxing’ holiday!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is waiting for Irma at the park for a picnic, when he sees a nervous man rehearsing an engagement proposal to his girlfriend. Mr Bean tries to show him how it’s done but manages to send the engagement ring flying! It lands in a bicycle basket, gets flicked into a pram, flung onto an ice cream - Mr Bean has to chase it around the park as it keeps being launched from place to place, in the hope he can save the day!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Mr. Bean meets an aristocratic old lady when he nearly runs over her lapdog with his mini. He’s thrilled to be invited for luncheon at her grand but strangely shabby mansion. Bean is determined to rise to the occasion. He’s so busy with matters of protocol he doesn’t notice that the lady and her sinister butler aren’t quite what they seem…

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is under strict instructions to water Mr Paliwal’s precious plant once a day while he’s on holiday. It’s all going fine, and Mr Bean is enjoying playing with his neighbour’s gadgets while he’s away. However, one day he forgets his task and has to let himself in late at night – but Mr Bean’s other neighbour, Bruiser, spots the suspicious activity, and thinks Mr Paliwal’s got a burglar!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is dismayed to find that the bin men are refusing to take his wheelie bin because the lid won’t shut as it’s too full of rubbish – and by the time he’s shut it, they’ve gone! So he sneaks the bin in front of other houses, hoping they won’t notice and pick it up. Meanwhile, Mrs Wicket realises that her purse has ended up in the rubbish, and is chasing Mr Bean… who is chasing the bin men!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: The gang tours an old Hollywood Studio, but they soon uncover a mystery concerning the ghost of a silent film comedy star who has returned to make sure his recently discovered final film is never seen!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: Fred lives out his childhood dream of being a stage magician as he and the gang go uncover at a private magic club being terrorized by a mutant Rabbit monster!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: While fighting over a jelly cake, Grizzy banishes the Lemmings to the castle dungeons and the rodents discover a passageway leading to a secret elfin room.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings take Polaroid snapshots of themselves disguised outside the castle along with a sheep who poses with them.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy is pulled out of his dreams by the rambunctious Lemmings who are jousting on sheep.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: With a ring that lets their astral bodies travel, the Lemmings decide to haunt Grizzy.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over a giant jelly cake. Their chase leads them to the castle library, where the Lemmings accidentally activate the opening of a secret passage.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover a card that enables them to teleport a magic closet.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: After seeing the flashy electric go-kart Mr Paliwal has bought for his daughter Divya, Mr Bean and Billy build their own using items around Mrs Wicket’s garden. At the go-kart track, Mr Bean and Mr Paliwal are unimpressed with Billy and Divya’s driving skills so take the karts for a “proper” race around the park. Meanwhile Mrs Wicket is on the warpath when she finds things missing from her house.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy head to the bowling alley with a free voucher, but Mr Bean finds it a lot harder than he expected. Seeing a little girl with a smaller ball, he borrows it, thinking it will be easier to use. But instead, he gets his fingers stuck in the ball and he causes havoc trying to pull them out.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is at a farmers’ market with Irma at her knitwear stall – right next to a man selling novelty teapots. Bean is instantly smitten with a green car-shaped one but can’t afford it. When he visits a food truck that’s laid out free samples, he hatches a plan to swipe them and sell them on his own stall so he can raise the cash for the teapot of his dreams!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is watching Clint Chiseljaw - his favourite action TV show - with Billy, but Mrs Wicket orders her nephew downstairs to finish his chores. Inspired by Clint’s catchphrase – “Nobody gets left behind”, Mr Bean tries a variety of different daring plans to break Billy out of Mrs Wicket’s flat. But none of them work, until he hits on the perfect plan… or so he thinks!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean joins Billy in trying to film his remote-controlled car so they can win an online video competition. But Mrs Wicket interrupts, asking them to set up the garden for Uncle Ron’s birthday party. While she’s off picking him up, they use the furniture to create the ultimate course for their video, but a wonky wheel on the car sends it straight into Ron’s massive birthday cake!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: When did Mr. Bean first meet his teddy bear? Did he really learn to drive his mini at the age of ten? Could he possibly have known his battle-axe of a landlady when she was a sweet and blushing bride? Bean takes us on a journey into the past, answering these questions and giving us an inkling as to what made him the man he is today.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko - Season 1
programme.desc: Jerry puts Tuffy to sleep but Tuffy sneaks out to play in his dollhouse. Tom sees Tuffy and tries to catch him. Tuffy and Jerry dress up in costumes to try and escape Tom. Tom chases them into the dollhouse but he is too big and ends up wearing the house instead.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: When Bam is covered in super bouncy Bounce X goo during a chase with Prank, he must learn to embrace and use his newfound bouncing abilities to his advantage if he's going to put a stop to Prank's latest scheme.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 3
programme.desc: The Batwheels are shocked to discover that a crime wave taking place in Gotham is being perpetrated by someone very familiar...

programme.title: Meet the Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: Robin's ride Redbird is on the case in this radical music video, as he sneaks and sleuths his way to stop Gotham's villains with his speed and detective skills - it's no mystery why Redbird is one of the best!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: Shaggy and Scooby's favorite chef is finally opening his own restaurant but a monstrous Yeti threatens the opening night. The gang has to solve the mystery before dessert is served, while Shaggy and Scooby have to resist eating all the food that's meant for the customers!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: Daphne had always dreamed of meeting extraterrestrial life, but that dream becomes a nightmare when the gang gets caught up in the mystery of a scary alien monster and brought to Area 53 - a government facility so secret, it's two numbers higher than Area 51!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover a very particular cocoa tree with chocolate-spread sap! Reduced to eating canned Brussels sprouts, the only remaining food in the cabin, Grizzy is baffled when he sees the Lemmings parading past to equip themselves with all sorts of containers: ladles, soup spoons, bowls, buckets, basins, etc. He watches them through binoculars and discovers that they have planted a faucet in a tree where chocolate spread flows. Grizzy decides to siphon off their tree.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy expels the Lemmings from the cabin where they had built a cumbersome obstacle course. Peaceful at last and feeling lazy, he is determined not to leave his couch. The Lemmings discover a magic Mayan disc that allows you to choose instantaneous mutations of other animals’ features: bat wings, reindeer antlers, elephant trunks, etc. The mutant Lemmings return to the cabin, determined to continue playing their game while enjoying their new accessories.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: As they fight over the last jar of chocolate spread, Grizzy and the Lemmings accidentally send it flying deep into the jungle. They both set out in search for the jar, but in a forest that dense, it’s an impossible mission. In a Mayan Temple, the Lemmings discover a magic bracelet that increases one’s sense of smell tenfold and use it to find the jar. Grizzy loses their trail, but finds some Mayan bracelets himself: one for eyesight and one for hearing. Enough to infallibly track down the Lemmings!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings discover a strange gateway to a parallel world. On the other side, there is the same cabin, only it doesn't belong to a ranger. It's a chocolate spread museum, where the curators are... another Grizzy and other Lemmings, all with very different personalities.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings clumsily destroy the TV remote control while fighting over who gets to watch their favorite program. While looking for a backup zapper, they happen onto a top secret Canadian Army prototype that enables you to apply the usual controls: play, pause and fast forward to living beings.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover that by changing the speed limit sign on the side of the road, they can accelerate truck traffic and create a huge draft that is just perfect for their extreme kiting game. Grizzy would be more in favor of a 20261109151500 +0000! or No Entrance! sign. A road sign battle begins.

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: It's back to basics as Specs attempts to catch Lamput with a net. Not being much good at anything at all physical, Specs ends up whacking himself on his own noggin. The blow shakes loose what little ability Specs had to function as an adult. He's transformed into a wailing infant who requires 24 hour care from his devoted... parents? Skinny and Lamput have to learn on the job. Taking care of a baby is hard. Especially if it's a giant annoying one.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: Jon, Min, and Miguel can’t wait to explore their new home base! But their welcome party takes a turn when the island’s most feared predator crashes the scene: Big Rex! Uncle Jack ushers them into safety in Dino Explorers HQ! Unbeknown to the ranchers, a duo of rascally compy's have stolen the HQ's system key throwing everything into chaos.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: The Ranchers take the Jungle Jetter on an underwater joyride—but their fun comes to a screeching halt when they catch the eye of Thunderfin, the island’s ill-tempered mosasaurus! With jaws snapping and tail thrashing, Thunderfin charges after them, forcing the kids to dive into the shadows of a nearby cave for cover!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean has to look after Mrs Wicket’s pet goldfish while she is away. With a ravenous Scrapper sniffing around Bean ends up becoming more bodyguard than babysitter. But when he manages to lose his fishy friend Mr Bean takes a nightmare journey down the sewer and back to his neighbour’s house via the park. Can Mr Bean get the pesky pet back in the bowl before Mrs Wicket returns home?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Paliwal is organising the neighbours for a street clean so they can win “Britain’s Tidiest Street”. But when the window cleaner cancels, Mr Bean sees a money-making opportunity and offers to help. He invents his own mobile window-cleaning device which works brilliantly! But rushing around with a long cleaning pole and a wheelie bin full of water might not have been the best idea when everyone’s rushing around.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean wins two tickets for an exotic cruise and naturally he takes Teddy along for the trip of a lifetime. Once aboard the huge ocean liner Mr Bean soon settles into a life of luxury but while showing off to a new friend Bean becomes ‘man overboard’ and stranded on a dessert island. The hungrier he gets the wilder he becomes and desperate to find a way off the island.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: The nasty tennis player is big and angry and wants his ball back. The one Mr. Bean managed to throw on the roof of a house across the road. Paralysed with vertigo sixty feet up on a windowsill, he is eventually brought to earth by the helpful intervention of a neighbour’s pet gerbil.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Baby Beaver is trying to build himself a winter home, but he just can't do it. His building keeps collapsing! A pebble from Baby Beaver's construction rolls up to the Baby Lemmings and introduces them to a new game: sliding pebbles up to a stick embedded in the frozen lake. The Baby Lemmings use Baby Beaver's stock of pebbles to indulge their new passion. Baby Beaver wants his pebbles back!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Winter has come! The Baby Lemmings discover the pure joy of sliding and playing on the ice. Their neighbor Baby Moose is not at all as delighted with the new weather conditions as they are – already naturally fearful, he’s thrown into a complete panic when his surroundings turn icy, cold and… sharp! He decides to secure the zone by breaking up all the frozen ice puddles and smashing all the icicles in his vicinity including the Baby Lemmings’ icicles. But his phobia causes him to fall into the middle of a frozen lake, and the Baby Lemmings have to rescue him.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Baby Lemmings knock down one of Baby Beaver's constructions, bowling style. He immediately gets angry and sends the lemmings off to play further away. But he soon runs out of branches for his construction. While he is looking for new ones, he notices that the Baby Lemmings have collected all the beautiful branches in the area to build a natural bowling alley! Baby beaver wants to take their branches, but the Baby Lemmings won't let him!

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Bugs awakens with a terrible case of cotton mouth. Will he be able to quench his thirst?

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Shifty tries to con Bugs and Squeaks at carnival games. Bugs wins in the end.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Squint Eatswood tries to bully his way into being Mayor of the Forest so Bugs has no choice but to run against him.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Shameless O'Scanty wants Bugs' lucky rabbit foot but Bugs is too attached to it to give it up.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko - Season 1
programme.desc: Jerry puts Tuffy to sleep but Tuffy sneaks out to play in his dollhouse. Tom sees Tuffy and tries to catch him. Tuffy and Jerry dress up in costumes to try and escape Tom. Tom chases them into the dollhouse but he is too big and ends up wearing the house instead.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: The gang's trip to the bayou is ruined by a shambling Swamp Beast that's scaring away anyone who dares to enter its soggy domain!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: The gang hits the ski slopes, although Daphne's more focused on nailing Fred with a revenge snowball. Their snowy fun is soon interrupted by the appearance of an evil Snowman Monster eager to scare all trespassers off his mountain.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: After a regrettable episode involving his landlady sleepwalking into his room, Mr. Bean suddenly finds himself out on his ear with nowhere to live. Near to tears, he yearns for the cosy familiarity of his old home. A scarecrow and a pair of false teeth come to his rescue.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean wins two tickets for an exotic cruise and naturally he takes Teddy along for the trip of a lifetime. Once aboard the huge ocean liner Mr Bean soon settles into a life of luxury but while showing off to a new friend Bean becomes ‘man overboard’ and stranded on a dessert island. The hungrier he gets the wilder he becomes and desperate to find a way off the island.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: A magician's hat is left behind at Ginger and Rick's house. Jerry runs into it, but when Tom reaches in after him, all he gets are multiple magician props. Tyke and Spike soon join in, and the top hat continues to wreak havoc.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: In Catsylvania, a strange flying bug bites Tom, transforming him into a Tom-sized bug monster. Van Mouseling saves the village with an old-fashioned canister of bug poison, and Tom flies off to the abandoned castle on the hill. But Tom's troubles aren't over yet! Inside, he must deal with huge spider webs and a spider the size of a truck.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: While mopping the kitchen floor, Tom uses an odd-looking sponge on a plate to clean up the mess. But the sponge turns out to be a rare truffle, which the estate's new pig ate. To pacify Cates, Tom and Jerry must find out whether the animal is also good at hunting truffles.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Lemmings play a new game, floating like flags in the breeze from the fan which is set at maximum. Grizzy, who has decided to watch his favorite TV documentary on salmon fish, quickly rids the living room of this interference. But he didn't anticipate that the Lemmings would continue their game on the roof with the wind pump and TV antenna, and that the interference would reappear... inside the TV!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Lemmings have a grand old time tearing down their Kapla block buildings, which they rebuild just as fast. Grizzy remarks that the she-bear he's in love with is impressed by the Lemmings' construction and makes believe that it's his work of art. But when the building collapses yet again, the she-bear walks off. Grizzy decides to build an even bigger one.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Lemmings draw inspiration from lessons they find in a martial arts book and start breaking every wooden object they can get their hands on into two. When Grizzy tries to stop them, they go on to the next lesson and get him in a judo hold. Grizzy understands that he needs the book so that he too can become a pro.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy dreams that he's a valiant knight who has just delivered his beloved. As he is about to take her in his arms, he is woken by the din of the Lemmings, who have chosen this particular day to blast music. Grizzy has only one desire: pick up his dream where he left off. But first, he'll have to stop the Lemmings' fiesta.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy stands in front of the pantry, desperate. The stock of chocolate spread is completely depleted. He realizes that the Lemmings are making some themselves, following a complicated recipe. If they can make it, then why can’t he?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Inspired by a magazine with a jewelry ad showing a man offering a diamond to a woman, Grizzy imagines himself offering the ranger's engagement ring to his beloved she-bear. But the big diamond set in the ring has disappeared. The Lemmings, who are having a spinning-top contest, are using it as the ultimate top. And they have no intention of giving it up.

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power - Season 1
programme.desc: Three New Kazoom Kids—friends of Finn, Kai, and Mia—appear unexpectedly in Kaboom City.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: While Green Lantern is having his spaceship repaired in the Batcave, the Batwheels want to play with his adorable alien pet, only to discover that this cute critter has wild alien powers!

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: When Poison Ivy uses a rare pollen-spewing flower to put all of Gotham to sleep, it's up to Bibi to save her friends and save the day.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 3
programme.desc: When Badcomputer activates his own satellite and takes control of every computer on Earth, the Batwheels must launch into space to stop him!

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 3
programme.desc: The Batwheels soar through space in their Bat-Rocket and have to navigate all sorts of orbiting obstacles to reach Badcomputer’s satellite.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 2
programme.desc: Marvin the Martian hires The Looney Builders to build an outer space ball court on Mars. Bugs is a big fan of the sport, and soon becomes a ball and build “hog.”

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 2
programme.desc: The Looney Builders build their headquarters a car wash. Daffy doesn’t want to wash Dumpy and goes to extreme lengths to keep him dirty and preserve their memories.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 2
programme.desc: Sunny Seagull hires The Looney Builders to build a carnival on Looneyburg’s pier. The crew gets so caught up trying to win the games that they lose sight of what matters.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 2
programme.desc: The Looney Builders take turns distracting Petunia as they build her a big surprise birthday cake in the back yard.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders: Hard Hat Time - Season 1
programme.desc: Lola leads the crew in washing their vehicles only to discover she mixed up the job assignments.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean is trying to find a nice quiet place to read his book so he sets off for the Library. But instead of reading he becomes distracted by some funny online videos he sees on the Library’s computer. Before he knows it Mr Bean is recording his own video which is uploaded for everyone to see. Things start to go crazy when people check out his funny video and his popularity takes off. But does Mr Bean enjoy being in the public eye and how long will his celebrity last?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean is obsessed by his favourite TV hero ‘Super Spy’ and is excited when his very own Super-Spy spy kit arrives in the post. While Mr Bean is pretending to be his favourite character and delighting in all his gadgets he spots some unusual goings on in the Bruisers’ house next door. Naturally Mr Bean assumes the worst and sets out to rectify the situation.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: When Mr Bean discovers that his favourite TV action star is in town, he takes a photo to be autographed – but the queue to meet him is massive! So, using a couple of props, he disguises himself as a security guard to get to the front – but he is caught out. How will Mr Bean get his autograph before TV star rushes off to catch his plane?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Irma and Mr Bean are invited across the road for dinner, and Mr Paliwal is particularly keen to show off his brand-new white sofa. As Mr Bean tests it out, he feels the squish of a chocolate bar in his back pocket and realises it’s gone all over the white cushions. Can Mr Bean clean the sofa before anyone notices?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy sets sail with his fishing gear. But he has no intention of fishing: it's a scheme to enjoy a jar of Yummy chocolate spread alone in peace. The Lemmings sense the subterfuge and sink his boat to get the treat, which sinks to the ocean depths. The characters dive in pursuit and discover a school of intelligent crabs that live in an underwater city. Their treasure is a substance that’s even yummier than Yummy.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings find the cabin upside down. Upon closer inspection, it looks like an epic battle took place there. And Grizzy isn't here. The curious Lemmings start imagining what could have happened, visualizing the most improbable scenes for us. They decide to follow their lead to find Grizzy and confirm their zany theories.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy dreams of drinking some nice cold coconut milk on the couch. Step one, get rid of the Lemmings who are having fun flying through the living room. Two, find coconuts that haven't been emptied of their nectar. While Grizzy struggles to pick coconuts that are too high up, the Lemmings find a magic conch. By simply dusting yourself with its sand, you can fly! It doesn't take Grizzy long to figure this out and the bear rapidly imagines himself as Peter Pan sipping on his easily-harvested coconut milk.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy wants to watch TV in peace. The Lemmings have other plans: they want to have fun playing music with homemade instruments. Exasperated by the racket they're making in the garage, Grizzy destroys the instruments and sends the Lemmings flying. The Lemmings discover a magic ukulele that bewitches anyone who hears its music: the perfect tool to regain control of the cabin and get back to their concert.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy can't sleep because it's too hot. He decides to confiscate the fans the Lemmings use to power their fake spaceship. Totally into their Space Opera game, the Lemmings try to repel the alien Grizzy with laser party favors and are propelled onto an unknown planet: a volcano crater with a secret base where a rocket is ready to take off. The rocket carries the cabin into space. It's no longer a game: Grizzy and the Lemmings will have to face the dangers of outer space!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings find a racket game linked to a prize distributor on a gas station parking lot. The more times you hit the ball without letting it touch the ground, the bigger the prize. With a series of 1,000 consecutive exchanges, the prize is a giant jar of Yummy chocolate spread! Grizzy has no qualms about cheating to win, but the outcome against the Lemmings is never certain. For they have nerves of steel when the stakes are high.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy uses insecticide and a fly swatter to get rid of vermin that are bothering him during his siesta. The Lemmings heal his last victim: a cute little insect they adopt as their house pet. Only problem, their starving mascot only eats wood! The cabin has lots of it, but when Grizzy realizes that an insect is eating his home from the inside, he takes drastic measures to eliminate it permanently.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy is too hot and proposes the Lemmings an exchange: their ventilator, which they use to propel their skateboard in the air, for a baby ostrich Grizzy found outside the cabin and who can tow them. The Lemmings are delighted to play with their new baby friend who is overflowing with energy. But the baby’s parents have a different outlook and do not want their son taking risks. Thinking that Grizzy is the Lemmings’ father, they hold him accountable.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy has played for too many hours on the console. His eyes are so fatigued he cannot stand a single ray of light. The Lemmings choose this very moment to throw a big birthday party with as many lights as possible! Grizzy goes to great lengths to settle the issue and decides to trip the power supply. The Lemmings discover a source of magical light deep in the savanna.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy watches the Lemmings play Hide-n-Seek and cannot refrain from sabotaging their game by revealing their hiding places. The Lemmings challenge him to play against them. The two sides outdo each other in cunning and trickery, but they are equally good. For the last decisive round, the opponents decide to extend the game zone to the entire savanna.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings have organized a mega party at the cabin. This is obviously not to Grizzy’s liking and the bear throws them out. The Lemmings discover a cave where the party is even more fun, but their ruckus drives out the bats who seek refuge in the cabin. Terrified of them, Grizzy tries everything to get rid of them and understands that the most effective thing is the Lemmings’ ghetto blaster.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy needs the fridge to keep his fish cold, but the Lemmings want it to make ice for their miniature ice skating rink. When Grizzy finds a new model robot air conditioner that is both rapid and efficient, the problem seems to be solved: each party will have their own source of cold. But when the Lemmings activate the robot’s artificial intelligence, the gadget starts to feel a powerful love for the person who resembles him most in his new surroundings: the fridge. Grizzy and the Lemmings will do everything to break up this budding romance and recover the cold sources that are rightfully theirs.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a white bear that fell out of a zoo’s refrigerated truck. After consulting the encyclopedia, he realizes that he and the bear are brothers of the same species! He decides to follow the encyclopedia’s instructions to the letter and take care of his brother during his hibernation. This runs counter to all of the Lemmings favorite activities. The Lemmings decide to create a false encyclopedia page which says that they too are bears. Grizzy is now obliged to treat them like brothers as well.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings’ hard rock concert is driving Grizzy mad. After kicking them out, Grizzy requisitions their ghetto blaster and listens to a relaxation cassette to calm down. The Lemmings discover an ancestral tree whose engraved strips of bark cast targeted maledictions. To recover their material, the Lemmings decide to drive Grizzy out by cursing him with the Ten Plaques of the Savanna.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Inspired by a magazine, Grizzy decides to redo the cabin’s interior design. To make sure everything is perfect, he ousts the Lemmings and their electric train. By chance, the Lemmings discover an underground futuristic premises in the middle of the savanna. From this secret place, they can see the entire savanna on a giant screen, down to the very inside of Grizzy’s cabin just like in a sandbox video game. By using the menus, they can have an impact on reality and thus... on Grizzy!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is waiting for Irma at the park for a picnic, when he sees a nervous man rehearsing an engagement proposal to his girlfriend. Mr Bean tries to show him how it’s done but manages to send the engagement ring flying! It lands in a bicycle basket, gets flicked into a pram, flung onto an ice cream - Mr Bean has to chase it around the park as it keeps being launched from place to place, in the hope he can save the day!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is under strict instructions to water Mr Paliwal’s precious plant once a day while he’s on holiday. It’s all going fine, and Mr Bean is enjoying playing with his neighbour’s gadgets while he’s away. However, one day he forgets his task and has to let himself in late at night – but Mr Bean’s other neighbour, Bruiser, spots the suspicious activity, and thinks Mr Paliwal’s got a burglar!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is dismayed to find that the bin men are refusing to take his wheelie bin because the lid won’t shut as it’s too full of rubbish – and by the time he’s shut it, they’ve gone! So he sneaks the bin in front of other houses, hoping they won’t notice and pick it up. Meanwhile, Mrs Wicket realises that her purse has ended up in the rubbish, and is chasing Mr Bean… who is chasing the bin men!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean drops Irma off at the airport – she and Lottie are going on a lovely sunny holiday without them. To cheer Teddy up, Mr Bean has a brainwave - don’t worry, we’ll have a holiday right here at home! So Mr Bean goes about recreating all the things he saw in Irma’s brochure – a flight on an Bean Airways and a stay at Hotel Bean with sea view and a pool! Hope Irma is having a great time too…

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: Lamput shows kindness to a nearby spider - and in the process makes a valuable ally. Good thing, too, because the mozzies around here are diabolical.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: When the Gardener finally gets his hands on Manny, Moley and Dotty are on his trail, so he dresses up as the world’s greatest Mole detective and lead them away from the clues.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: Mishmosh’s new de-aging device causes trouble when it accidentally zaps Miss Petunia and Old Coot into their younger selves. But Moley soon discovers that the de-aging doesn’t stop and he and his friends must rescue them before it’s too late.

programme.title: Slepkavība motelī
programme.desc: 2020. gada 6. septembra rītā policija saņem satraucošu zvanu uz 911 - 32 gadus vecais Braiens Džemals Redings raud un kliedz, ka atradis savu 16 gadus veco draudzeni Saipresu Nūnanu mirušu Forest Motel numuriņā Ridžlendā. Saipresa Nūnana neizdzīvoja pēc šāviena galvā. Viņas ķermenis tika atrasts uz gultas, kas liek domāt, ka viņa nebija baidījusies no uzbrucēja. Kad ierodas izmeklētāji, Braiena Redinga dīvainā uzvedība nozieguma vietā rada nopietnas aizdomas.

programme.title: Ņujorkas slepkavība
programme.desc: Linda Steina bija slavenību nekustamo īpašumu māklere, viņa pārdeva Ņujorkas luksusa dzīvokļus Stīvenam Spīlbergam, Brūsam Vilisam un Betei Midlerei. Kad Linda tiek atrasta mirusi savā dzīvoklī, slepkavība nekavējoties kļūst par avīžu pirmo lapu ziņu. Viņas personība bija sarežģīta, un Linda bija ieguvusi kā ienaidniekus, tā cienītājus. Ar ierobežotiem pierādījumiem no nozieguma vietas, tikai rūpīga meklēšana var identificēt viņas slepkavu.

programme.title: Velkami per betoną
programme.desc: Policininkai Bretas Ridžmenas ir Entonis Lurazetis (aktoriai Mel‘as Gibson‘as ir Vince‘as Vaughn‘as) karštakošiai cinikai, nevengiantys įžeidžiančių replikų kitos rasės, tautybės ir lyties asmenims bei sutariantys, kad jėgos panaudojimas negali būti per didelis ar netinkamas. Po vieno tokio jėgos panaudojimo paaiškėja, kad jis vis tik buvo netinkamas ir abu policininkai nušalinami nuo pareigų.Stokojantys grynųjų ir neturėdami kito pasirinkimo, šie du sugadinti kareiviai stačia galva panyra į nusikalstamą pasaulį, manydami, kad užsidirbs lengvų pinigų, tačiau tamsiausiuose šešėliuose atranda žymiai „daugiau“ nei kada nors tikėjosi.

programme.title: Bjaurusis aš 2
programme.desc: Kol buvęs užkietėjęs piktadarys Gru pratinasi prie šeimyninio gyvenimo ir bando sąžiningai pelnytis iš uogienės verslo, pavagiama slaptoji Arkties laboratorija. Kovos su niekšais sąjunga nusprendžia, kad jai reikia savo žmogaus, ir pasamdo besispyriojantį Gru jiems padėti. Kartu su ekscentriška Kovos su niekšais sąjungos agente Liusi Vaild Gru sutaria, kad jo pagrindinis įtariamasis yra žuvusiu laikomas užkietėjęs niekšas El Mačo, kurio nepilnametis sūnus taip pat turi ketinimų dėl Gru vyresnės dukters Margo. Akivaizdžiai apakintas perdėtos savo vaikų apsaugos ir vis didėjančio potraukio Liusei, Gru eina klaidingu keliu net tuomet, kai jo pakalikai tyliai vienas po kito pagrobiami neaiškiems piktavalių tikslams...

programme.title: Paslaptinga karalystė
programme.desc: Jaunoji Merė Katerina grįžta į savo tėvo, ekscentriško mokslininko, namus, bet šio visa apimantis troškimas atrasti mažųjų padarų civilizaciją gretimame miške neleidžia jiems suartėti. Tačiau Merę netrukus sumažina šio miško karalienė Torė, kurią mirtinai sužeidė trūnijantys boganai, ir įpareigoja kokoną su nauja karaliene pernešti į saugią vietą. Kartu su veteranu kovotoju Giriniu, dviem paikais moliuskais ir jaunuoju keistuoliu Merė sutinka padėti. Kai piktasis boganų vadas Mandragas priartėja, Merė ir jos naujieji draugai turi suvienyti pastangas ir rasti būdą, kaip išgelbėti savo pasaulį.

programme.title: Le Manas'66. Plento karaliai
programme.desc: Dviem Oskarais apdovanota, tikrais įvykiais paremta juosta apie lenktynes, pakeitusias „Ford“ markės automobilių istoriją. Prestižinėse „Le Mano“ lenktynėse karaliaujantis „Ferrari“ buvo nenugalimas. Tačiau tai įkvėpė „Ford“ vadovą Henrį Fordą II siekti sėkmės bet kokia kaina. Jis žengė rizikingą ir labai abejotiną sėkmę žadantį žingsnį. Į komandą pasikvietęs genialų ir talentingą lenktynininką Keną Mailsą (Christian Bale) ir išradingąjį inžinierių Kerolą Šelbį (Matt Damon) jis davė savo komandai tris mėnesius iki naujų lenktynių. Po alinančio darbo, įtampos ir bemiegių naktų, tai, kas atrodė neįmanoma, tapo realybe. Visiškai naujas „Ford GT40” nuvertė nuo sosto „Ferrari“ ir buvo nepralenkiamas trejus metus. „Ford GT40“ modelis tapo legenda ir geriausiai atpažįstamu automobilių pasaulio istorijoje.

programme.title: Ledynmetis 2. Eros pabaiga
programme.desc: Žemę dengiantis ledas pradeda tirpti, visiems priešistoriniams gyvūnams suteikdamas daug džiaugsmo. Dabar jie gali maudytis, šokinėti nuo tramplinų, grožėtis geizeriais ar turkštis natūraliose purvo voniose. Niekas net neįtaria, kad artėjantis potvynis gali sunaikinti visą slėnį. Laimei, apie tai pirmieji sužino mamutas Manfredas, tigras Diegas ir tinginys Sidas. Šaunioji trijulė ne tik privalo perspėti visus apie gresiantį pavojų, bet ir sugalvoti būdą, kaip pasprukti nuo artėjančio potvynio!

programme.title: Ledynmetis 3
programme.desc: Elinį kartą besivaikydamas gilę Skretas netikėtai susipažįsta su evoliucijos keliu šiek tiek toliau pažengusia vovere skraiduole, viliokliškai klapsinčia savo ilgomis blakstienomis. Mamutas Menis su naująja savo drauge Eli laukiasi mažylio. Kardadantis tigras ima pastebimai nervintis, kad jį visi laiko vos ne namine kate. Sidas, prisižiūrėjęs į savo draugą mamutą, ir pats užsinori sukurti šeimą bei iš to begalinio noro pavagia dinozauro kiaušinį. Žinoma, tai buvo klaida. Šaunieji „Ledynmečio“ herojai priversti leistis į pavojingą kelionę, kad išvaduotų savo draugą iš paslaptingo, nepažįstamo ir bauginančio pasaulio. Šioje nuotykių nestokojančioje odisėjoje jiems teks susidurti su naujais pavojais. Tačiau vieni jie neliks. Jiems padės naujas veikėjas – negailestinga vienaakė dinozaurus medžiojanti žebenkštis, vardu Bakas.

programme.title: Ledynmetis. Žemynų atsiradimas
programme.desc: Ar žinote, kaip iš tikrųjų susiformavo žemynai? Viskas prasidėjo nuo mažytės voveriuko Skreto gilės. Menkas bakstelėjimas ledyno paviršiuje baigėsi kontinentų atsiskyrimu. Po šio geografinio perversmo Mamutas Menis, tigras Diego, tinginys Sidas ir jo močiutė atsidūrė vidury vandenynų išlaikomi tik menkos ledo lyties. Bičiuliai darys viską, kad išgelbėtų savo kailius ir susitiktų kitus draugus bei šeimos narius. Kelionėje jų laukia neatrastos žemės, egzotiška gamta ir nematytais gyvūnais apgyvendintas piratų laivas! Kompanijai pavyks pasprukti nuo užpuolikų, bet šie bandys herojus pavyti ir atkeršyti. Įspūdingi nuotykiai įtrauks visą šeimą, o filmas bus puiki geografijos pamoka mažiesiems ir linksma pramoga suaugusiems. Filmą įgarsino žinomi šalies žmonės: Rimas Šapauskas (Manfredas), Arūnas Sakalauskas (Sidas), Dainius Svobonas (Diegas), Evelina Kauklienė (Elė), Džiugas Siaurusaitis (Krešas), Algis Dainavičius (Edis), Irmantas Jankaitis (Kapitonas Gutas), Elvyra Žebertavičiūtė (Močiutė), Oneida Kunsunga (Persikutė), Agne Šataitė (Šira).

programme.title: Ledynmetis. Susidūrimas
programme.desc: Išdykęs voveriukas Skretas ir vėl pridarys bėdų. Savo išsvajotą gilę jis randa įšalusioje skraidančioje lėkštėje ir bandydamas ją ištraukti iš ledo pajudina svirtį bei netikėtai išskrenda į kosmosą. Ten Skretas vėl neapsieina be nuotykių – prisidirba tiek, kad Žemės link pažyra daugybė meteorų. Šios „krentančios žvaigždės“ Žemėje gyvenantiems gyvūnams laimės neatneš. Jie turės kuo skubiau ieškoti, kur pasislėpti. Per mamutų Menio ir Elės vestuvių metines meteorai įbaugina susirinkusius svečius, tampa aišku, kad romantikos čia nebus, nors vestuvėms ruošiasi ir jų dukra, apie šeimos pagausėjimą galvoja Diegas, tik Sidas jaučiasi vienišas. Tad saugodami savo gyvybes Menis, Elė, Sidas, Diegas ir kiti palieka namus ir leidžiasi į ilgą kelionę, kurioje bus pavojų, rizikos, tačiau netrūks ir juoko, atradimų bei naujų, spalvingų draugų!

programme.title: Dino Dana
programme.desc: Dana on innukas 10-aastane tüdruk, kes armastab dinosauruseid. Kohe nii väga, et isa valmistas talle erilise seljakoti, mille abil ta saab muutuda ükskõik milliseks dinosauruseks. Ees ootavad vägevad dinoseiklused!

programme.title: Teaduspauk
programme.desc: Teadus-mustkunstnik Eric jagab saladusi teaduse, tehnoloogia, inseneriteaduse ja matemaatika maailmast, et õpetada lastele, kuidas üllatada oma sõpru ja perekonda STEM-põhiste võlutrikkide ja käsitööga! Kujutage ette, et saate teha telefonile kõlarid vaid mõnest tavalisest majapidamises kasutatavast esemest või luua kõrgelennulise raketi pudeli, sooda ja veega. See kõik on võimalik läbi teaduse jõu!

programme.title: Ahne aju
programme.desc: Lõbus sari, mis süveneb meie maailma põnevatesse avastustesse, täis huvitavaid fakte ajaloo, teaduse, spordi, moe, isetegemise, retseptide, loomade ja maagia kohta.

programme.title: Matapauk
programme.desc: Eric Leclerc on matemaatik ja otsekui mustkunstnik näitab ta meile kui müstiliselt huvitav on matemaatika, mis peidab end kõikjal meie ümber. Matapauk õpetab väga lõbusal ja huvitaval kombel meid kõiki matemaatikat armastama.

programme.title: Hiiglaslikud teaduskatsed
programme.desc: Mis saab siis, kui tavalisest teaduskatsest teha midagi tõeliselt suurt? Suur läbikukkumine? Või hoopis ülipõnev ja kohutavalt lõbus etendus?

programme.title: Ajurünnak
programme.desc: Oled sa kunagi mõelnud, kas ilma tiibadeta on võimalik lennata? Või kõndida mööda vesiliiva? Kaks last esitavad võimatuna näiva väljakutse ning sukelduvad koos saatejuhtidega teadusmaailma.

programme.title: Noored kangelased
programme.desc: Põnev sari, kus lapsed võistlevad kahes suures väljakutses, mis on inspireeritud tõestisündinud kangelasteost.

programme.title: Andy eelajaloolised seiklused
programme.desc: Andy töötab muuseumis ning tema kasutada on ajamasin, mis viib ta tagasi eelajaloolisse aega, et ta saaks sealt kaasa tuua sulgi, luid ja kõike muud, mida muuseumi ekspositsioon vajab. Tänu oma seljakotis olevatele vajalikele abivahenditele jõuab ta alati ohutult tänapäeva muuseumi tagasi.

programme.title: Hirmus ajalugu
programme.desc: See on energiline, üllatav ja tavapäratu kujutlus ajaloo kõige jubedamatest, kuid samas naljakamatest sündmustest. Muserdavatest maailmasõdadest ja kurvast keskajast võikate viikingite ning kihvtide kreeklasteni. Ajalugu pole kunagi olnud nii ulakas.

programme.title: Andy reisiseiklused
programme.desc: Andy, Jen ja Scout reisivad oma keskkonnasõbraliku masinaga mööda maailma ja avastavad looduse saladusi ning loomade uskumatut käitumist.

programme.title: Matapauk
programme.desc: Eric Leclerc on matemaatik ja otsekui mustkunstnik näitab ta meile kui müstiliselt huvitav on matemaatika, mis peidab end kõikjal meie ümber. Matapauk õpetab väga lõbusal ja huvitaval kombel meid kõiki matemaatikat armastama.

programme.title: Vägevad masinad
programme.desc: Mootorrattur Grace istub juhiistmel ja tutvustab publikule maailma suurimaid, kiiremaid ja vägevamaid masinaid.

programme.title: Meister igal alal
programme.desc: Kümme noorsportlast osalevad ülimal spordivõistlusel. Trikk on aga selles, et nad ei võistle oma spordialadel, vaid teiste võistlejate aladel. Võistluse lõpus enim punkte kogunud sportlane pälvib tiitli Meister igal alal.

programme.title: Lahedad loomad
programme.desc: Alates surfavatest hiirtest ja maalivatest koertest kuni rääkivate hobuste ning trühvlisigadeni. Kõige kavalamad, nunnumad ja pöörasemad loomad.

programme.title: Andy safari seiklused
programme.desc: Andy töötab Safari maailmas, kogu Maakera kõige suuremas ja paremas looduspargis koos oma ülemuse, härra Hammondi ja tehnikavõluri Jeniga. Mistahes huvitav ülesanne teda ees ka ei ootaks, kihutab Andy oma safari-autoga kohale.

programme.title: Joonistame koos
programme.desc: Maailmakuulsate Marveli, Ämblikmehe ja Tähesõdade koomiksiraamatute kunstnik Will Sliney näitab, kuidas joonistada tegelasi maailma tuntumatest multikatest, nagu näiteks „Käsna-Kalle Kantpüks“, „Vali maja“, „Boss Beebi“, „Käpapatrull“ ja paljud teised.

programme.title: Andy veeseiklused
programme.desc: Andy naaseb vaimustavate veeseiklustega. Avasta temaga koos veekogusid üle kogu maakera ning kohtu delfiinide, vaalade ja muude hämmastavate loomadega.

programme.desc: Jei savo virtuvėje jaučiatės labiau svečiais nei šeimininkais, jums į pagalbą atskubės Kotryna Starkienė! Šį sezoną įvairius sezoninius patiekalus iš savo pačios užsiaugintų gėrybių ji ruoš ne tik žiūrovams jau pažįstamoje sodyboje, bet pakvies apsilankyti ir didmiesčio virtuvėje. Čia žiūrovų lauks gardūs, tačiau tuo pat metu ir lengvi, laiką taupyti padedantys receptai. programme.title: Angelas sargas
programme.desc: Šivradžas ir Rasal – vienas kitą mylintys brolis ir sesuo. Netekę mylimos mamos, vaikai užgauliojami bendraamžių ir engiami kaimynų. Brolis jaučia didelę atsakomybę apsaugoti mažąją sesutę, tad tampa tikru apsaugos skydu kasdieniuose iššūkiuose. Gyvenimas pasisuka dramatiškai, kai vaiku tėvas patenka į avariją ir susiduria su paslaptingos ginkluotos grupuotės nariais. Dabar vaikams teks dar labiau saugoti vienam kitą. programme.title: Autorius ir aš
programme.desc: Vestuvinių prekių parduotuvei vadovaujanti Eba verčiasi ir vasarnamių nuoma. Atostogų namelį išsinuomoja žavus rašytojas Rasmusas, kuris prie jūros tikisi ramiai pabaigti rašomą romaną. Rasmusas toli gražu nespinduliuoja draugiškumu ir Ebai kelia nemažai problemų. Viskas pasikeičia, kai išsikalbėjus paaiškėja, kad jie abu yra Biancos Lund meilės romanų gerbėjai. Ši bendrystė suartina Ebą ir Rasmusą. Pabaigęs rankraštį, romanistas visą laiką praleidžia su žavinga vasarnamio nuomotoja. Ebos draugė Livė nerimauja, kad jos sužadėtinis visiškai nesidomi vestuvių planavimu. O bičiulė Tildė susiginčija su Rasmusą lankančiu leidėju Svenu. Ginčo metu paaiškėja, kad jauna autorė Lilit Holm savo debiutiniame romane panaudojo didelę Biankos Lund romano dalį. Kas tiksliai nuo ko nukopijavo tekstą? Kaip baigsis Livės vestuvių pasiruošimas? Ar Rasmusas ir Eba bendraus pasibaigus vasarai?

Čia žiūrovų lauks gardūs, tačiau tuo pat metu ir lengvi, laiką taupyti padedantys receptai. Žiūrovų laukia patarimai, kaip pasiruošti maisto visai savaitei, ką įdėti vaikams į priešpiečių dėžutes ar kaip greitai ir nebrangiai paruošti patiekalus draugų vakarienei.

programme.title: Be namų
programme.desc: Serialas sukurtas remiantis Daivos Vaitkevičiūtės apysaka „Trise prieš mafiją“, kuri 2006 m. pripažinta „Metų knyga“ paauglių kategorijoje ir yra leidžiama vis naujais tiražais. „Be namų“ – tai gyvenimiška drama, kurioje susipina jautrūs vaikų likimai, detektyvinės mįslės bei nuoširdi draugystė, lydima įkvepiančių svajonių, linksmų ir šiurpių nuotykių. Serialo centre – vaikų globos namų auklėtinė Emilija ir jos draugai – našlaitis, pravarde Kobė, ir Kasparas. Šio tėvai mįslingai dingsta. Veiksmas rutuliojasi mažame Lietuvos miestelyje, kuriame daug saulės, bet mažai meilės. Vietinių globos namų auklėtiniai kasdien susiduria ne tik su geraširde direktore ir rūpestingu ūkvedžiu, bet ir su žiauria auklėtoja.

programme.title: Gero gyvenimo receptas
programme.desc: Žurnalistė Hana išgyvena skyrybas su mylimuoju. Tomas svajoja apie gausią šeimą, o Hana niekaip negali pastoti. Aplinkiniai nepalaiko skuboto skyrybų sprendimo ir tikina, kad verta apsvarstyti įsivaikinimo galimybę. Tačiau Hana nusprendžia nutraukti pašlijusius santykius. Grįžusi į tėvų namus, ji susipažįsta su vargonų statytoju Mikaeliu ir jo dukra Luna. Vyriškis yra susitaręs dėl miestelio bažnyčios vargonų atkūrimo. Hanos tėvas, miestelio klebonas, trokšta kuo greičiau atkurti instrumentą, o jo žmona Bilė labai neigiamai nusiteikusi prieš Mikaelį. Moteris nepaliaujamai skleidžia abejones dėl šio vyriškio sugebėjimų ir nori kuo skubiau jį atleisti. Hana susidraugauja su Mikaeliu ir viskas klostosi kuo puikiausiai, kol neišaiškėja siaubinga tiesa. Hanos mama Bilė yra biologinė Mikaelio mama! Ar gali būti, kad Hana įsimylėjo savo tikrą brolį? Kaip mergina sureaguos sužinojusi, kad laukiasi?

programme.title: Gero vakaro šou
programme.desc: Nestokojant puikaus humoro čia kalbinami žymūs Lietuvos žmonės, netikėtais kampais atskleidžiant jų portretus, skamba gyvo garso pasirodymai, laidos svečiai atlieka netikėčiausias užduotis.

programme.title: Moterų laimė
programme.desc: „Moterų laimės“ pirmasis sezonas pasakojo apie buvusią namų šeimininkę, vienišą mamą ir tris jaunas, nepatyrusias merginas, kurios ėmėsi bendro verslo ir dėl to nuolat kovojo su gyvenimo negandomis. Šią vasarą „Moterų laimės“ pagrindinė istorija suksis apie vieną heroję – aštuoniolikmetę Mildą, užaugusią vaikų namuose ir netikėtai atsidūrusią sostinėje. Milda – drąsi, nebijanti pakovoti už save, tačiau gyvenimas Vilniuje bus visai ne toks, kokio ji tikėjosi. Čia jos lauks susitikimas su biologine mama, nelegalus darbas... Herojė ne savo noru įsivels į kriminalinę veiklą, o šis jos biografijos šešėlis tikrai nepadės ateityje – nei karjeroje, nei meilėje. Į šią istoriją įsivels ne tik jaunas perspektyvus verslininkas, bet ir pagiežingas, herojei į tėvus tinkantis vyras. Tiesa, jų tikslai bus labai skirtingi...

programme.title: Ieškant dukros
programme.desc: Žiaurų likimo smūgį patyrusi Hidžran niekaip negali susitaikyti su kūdikio praradimu. Mintys apie gimdymo metu mirusią dukrelę lydi moterį kiekviename žingsnyje. Nors gydytojai ligoninėje teigė, kad kūdikis neišgyveno, Hidžran nuojauta kužda ką kita. Troškimas sutikti dukrelę dega jaunos moters širdyje ir suteikia jėgų gyventi.Vieną dieną Hidžran pamato šalikelje stovinčiame automobilyje dūstančią mergaitę. Moteris nelieka abejinga ir puola gelbėti mažylę. Nepaisydama savo saugumo, ji sugeba ištraukti negaluojančią mergaitę iš automobilio. Deja, netrukus pasirodžiusiam jos tėvui Emre ši situacija pasirodo labiau panaši į vaiko pagrobimą, nei į norą padėti. Hidžran sulaikoma ir ilgai tardoma dėl šio incidento. Laimei, peržiūrėję gatvę filmuojančių vaizdo kamerų įrašus, pareigūnai išleidžia Hidžran į laisvę. Mažosios Melek tėvas privalo atsiprašyti geraširdės moters. Jis puikiai supranta, kad tik Hidžran dėka jo mažoji dukrelė vis dar gyva.Sužinojęs, kad Hidžran ieško darbo, Emre nedvejodamas pasiūlo jai dirbti prabangiuose savo namuose ir būti Melek aukle. Mergina sutinka ir apsigyvena Melek šeimos dvare. Nuo pat pirmos akimirkos auklė pakliūva į siautulingą intrigų liūną. Šeimą skaldo dramatiškos paslaptys, kova dėl valdžios ir chaosas. Tačiau dabar visi likimo smūgiai tampa pakeliami, nes Melek ir Hidžran turi viena kitą. Mergaitės ir jos auklės tandemą apgaubia pasitikėjimo, pagarbos ir meilės skydas, nors jos net nenutuokia, kad yra motina ir dukra.
